title: Large Factory Multiblocks
description: The &3Chemical Factory&r is a large version of the &3Chemical Plant&r, capable of performing 4 recipes in parallel. It has double the speed of the chemical plant but consumes twice as much power. Additionally, it consumes &bWater&r as a coolant, and produces &bLow-Pressure Steam&r, so a closed water cycle is recommended.
The &3Assembly Factory&r is a large version of the &3Assembly Machine&r, capable of performing 4 recipes in parallel. It functions the same as the chemical factory.
